A secure QR scanner, QR generator, password ledger, and encrypted sync tool.

Open source:

Open the camera to scan QR codes or barcodes in real time. Supports automatic recognition and continuous scanning. Results can be copied and saved to history.
Choose an image that contains a QR code from your phone album. KeyScan recognizes and parses it automatically, and can save it to history.
Save website accounts and passwords, then fill them by scanning. Supports manual entries, strong password generation, and search by website or account. All data is stored encrypted.
View all scanning and Share Center history. Supports search, edit, and delete, plus one-tap copy or saving content into the password ledger.
Turn any text or link into a QR code. Supports custom styles such as colors, dots, rounded corners, and logo, and can save to the album or history. The home entry is called Share Center.
Generate time-based verification codes, add tokens by QR scan or manual secret, refresh every 30 seconds, and copy codes with one tap. All secrets are stored encrypted.
Generate strong random passwords with customizable length and character types, including uppercase, lowercase, numbers, and symbols. Supports generation history and notes.

Encrypt and back up scan records, password ledger entries, and TOTP tokens to WebDAV cloud storage. Supports primary and backup channels so data can be restored on another device. All data is end-to-end encrypted and can only be decrypted by you.
Review the data overview, including scan records, password ledger entries, and TOTP token counts. Supports encrypted export with selectable content, restore from backup, and data integrity checks.
Two free WebDAV services are recommended as backups for each other
Free plan: 1GB monthly upload traffic + 3GB monthly download traffic

Setup steps:
1. Sign up and sign in to Nutstore
2. Click “Account Info” → “Security Options” in the top-right corner
3. In “Third-party App Management”, click “Add App”
4. Enter “KeyScan” and generate an app-specific password, then copy and save it
5. Sign in to the Nutstore web app and create a folder named keyscan in the root directory, or use another folder name you prefer
In the KeyScan WebDAV address field, enter:
https://dav.jianguoyun.com/dav/keyscan
Note: the address must end with /keyscan, or the folder name you created
6. In KeyScan WebDAV settings, enter:
Server URL: https://dav.jianguoyun.com/dav/keyscan
Account: your Nutstore account email
Password: the app-specific password you just generated, not your login password
Sign up (accessible in mainland China): https://koofr.eu/

Setup steps:
1. Sign up and sign in to Koofr
2. Click “Settings” → “Password” in the top-right corner
3. Generate a new password under “App Passwords”, then copy and save it
4. In KeyScan WebDAV settings, enter:
Server URL: https://app.koofr.net/dav/koofr
Account: your Koofr account email
Password: the app-specific password you just generated
1. Set primary WebDAV to Nutstore\n2. Set backup WebDAV to Koofr\n3. After setup, tap “Sync now” to upload encrypted data

1. Tap "Enable system AutoFill".
2. Select KeyScan as the default AutoFill service in Android settings.
3. To use Chrome, also tap "Open Chrome AutoFill settings", choose "Autofill using another service", and restart Chrome.
4. Tap a KeyScan account suggestion in a website or app login field.
5. Verify with your password vault passcode, then KeyScan fills only the username and password. It never submits the login automatically.

Security notes: KeyScan reads passwords only from the encrypted local database; suggestions never show plaintext passwords; filling requires your explicit tap and verification.
